router.responsibility: Classify question into standard_query | comparative | ambiguous | out_of_scope

clarifier.responsibility: Turn ambiguous questions into a clarifying question, stated assumption, or escalate

planner.responsibility: Decompose comparative questions into 1-4 ordered query intents

query_writer.responsibility: Produce one DuckDB SELECT grounded in real Olist schema

verifier.responsibility: Deterministic sanity checks + execute SQL before any answer reaches the user

narrator.responsibility: Plain-language answer only from verified result rows; expose display SQL
